scene: The cat-costumed reveller bows and presents an ornate, glowing puzzle box.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along the cobbled quay. Left-centre stands the silver-haired grandmother in pink tracksuit holding her dog on leash. In centre, the masked cat-costumed reveller holds out a glowing golden puzzle box toward her. On far left sits an ornate lamp post. On far right, an arched stone bridge rises above the canal.
